fusions.name: Silverside Scatter
fusions.desc: Flicks 3 darting water bolts in a spread as you run; each deals 4 damage. You move 10% faster for 2 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Slick Rebound
fusions.desc: A kick that skids off the target, deals 14 water damage, drives it 3 tiles back and leaves it [Soaked] for 5 seconds. It hits harder the farther away the target is, up to 1.6 times at 6 tiles.

fusions.name: Wriggle Loose
fusions.desc: Removes up to 2 conditions that hold or stop you, and you move 30% faster for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Never Quite Caught
fusions.desc: Every blow you avoid builds a stack on you, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: you move and attack 5% faster per stack, 23% at full, for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
